paper_reference: Joint Routing and Wireless Charging Scheduling for Electric Vehicles with Shuttle Services
dynamic_price_reference: synthetic time-of-use schedule matching paper's reported range
notes: Synthetic dataset generated to match all explicit numerical settings in the paper.
Road network is k-nearest-neighbor connected in a 60x60 km region.
Pickups and deliveries are represented by unique node pairs.
Charging is enabled at all pickup and delivery nodes, plus start/end nodes.
